### Shared platform flags

| Flag | Description |
| - | - |
| `--api-key <key>` | MCPJam `sk_`
API key (overrides `MCPJAM_API_KEY`) |\n| `--api-url <url>` | MCPJam API base URL (defaults to `https://app.mcpjam.com/api/v1`) |\
n| `--api-header <header...>` | Extra request header as `\"Name: value\"`, repeatable — for a deployment behind Cloudflare Access,
a WAF, or a corporate proxy. Also `MCPJAM_API_HEADERS`, one per line. Cannot set `authorization`, `idempotency-key`, or `content-

type`. |

### `cloud projects servers connect`

Start a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent,
and validation happen asynchronously. When the server requires OAuth, the command prints a private authorization link and (by defa
ult) opens it in a browser. The command then polls until the request reaches a terminal status.\n\n| Flag | Required | Description

|
| - | - | - |
| `--url <url>` | Yes | MCP server URL to connect |
| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID |
|
`--server <id>` | No | Existing server ID, when the project has several on this URL |\n| `--name <name>` | No | Name for the serve
r, if one is created |\n| `--reauthorize` | No | Force a fresh authorization |\n| `--no-browser` | No | Print the authorization li

nk instead of opening it |
| `--no-wait` | No | Return as soon as the request is created |

With `--no-wait`, the command print
s the request id and exits immediately. The request continues in the cloud; use `connect-status` to check it and `connect-cancel`
to stop it.\n\nEach pending request holds one of the account's five concurrent-connection slots for up to an hour. If `connect` re
ports `ACTIVE_REQUEST_LIMIT`, the error details include the ids of the open requests — cancel the abandoned ones with `connect-can

cel` to free slots.
